gmap_id is not a Google Places API Place ID, so google_place_id is pending:gmap:<gmap_id>. That keeps it out of sync_targets; do not send it to the Places API.
google_rating is the mean of the 2833 review stars; user_rating_count is the review count in this dump.
reviews.text is NOT NULL. 1163 reviews are star-only in the source; they are stored as empty text with text_missing=true.
source_id / external_review_id are UUIDv5 of gmap_id|user_id|time, so re-runs upsert instead of duplicating.
author_uri is the Google Maps contributor URL built from user_id. Photo URLs are dropped. Owner responses are kept in JSON only (no column in the schema).
published_at comes from the source epoch milliseconds, stored in UTC.

Where to start? If you come to Anchorage and don’t find your way to the Moose’s Tooth (or their sister location, the Bear Tooth) you have done your travel planning all wrong. The place is an experience, the pizza unique and delicious, the beer is some of the best brewed in Alaska. Their brand swag is worn proudly by locals...which says a lot. Of course, a popular place like this requires a wait (no reservations). We always get drinks and play charades. The Backpacker’s Pizza is one of our favorites but there is no bad choice. Their home brew root beer and cream soda are worth the calories as is the Hungarian Mushroom Soup (and I don’t even really like mushrooms). The beer selection is wide and it is worth noting that many competing restaurants carry their brews. If you are having a special event, they have a side room that they rent at certain days/times during the week. In addition to fantastic food they host First Tap Thursday’s and many concerts during the year...so be sure to check their website. They are also a great spot for to-go orders as they have designated parking and registers for those picking up. The staff is a mix of familiar faces who have been there forever and teens and college students who have always been welcomed as employees. Everyone is friendly and they have creative combo suggestions, so make sure to ask! If you want the experience but not the wait, I’ve found that between 2:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. the crowd thins a bit and tables turn over quickly.

Moose's Tooth is a local land mark of food and for good reason. While everyone from all walks of life have definitely found their place for "the best place for pizza on the planet". Moose's Tooth is Anchorage's. Do not go here expecting to get a regular pizza, because you'll leave disappointed. Go here for a great twists on old classics with flavor to match. Personally I'm a fan of the chipotle steak pizza but I can safely order any of their pizzas and be satisfied with what I get.

For those looking to partake in some more adult beverages, Moose's has a healthy selection of beers on tap ranging the gambit. If you so happen to find a drink that sparks your interest but you want to take some home. Well fear not, for you can order "growlers" of your favorite drink to go.

Now for the down side.

With great popularity, comes a hefty bill. Moose's Tooth has good food and the popularity and they know it, so they are going to make you wallet feel it. A large pizza here will run you the tune of $40+. Now once you get over the sticker shock, good luck finding a parking spot. While the place a large parking lot, their popularity sees to it that it's always full. I suggest you either car pool or be prepared to walk from down the road for when you do find a place to park. Now that you parked your car, get ready to take a seat and.....Wait. The waiting lines routinely run out the door. For a party of two at dinner hours, expect a 40+ minute wait. Party of 4, a hour and a half. Larger parties..... well good luck to ya.

In closing, I find myself keep coming back time and time again and you can expect yourself to do the same.

I opted for the sampler, and let her choose for me most of the night when I wanted something else... she didn't disappoint! So, the menu... there's a huge selection of pizzas and things to try, it's overwhelming how much you want to taste everything. Without a doubt my favorite place in Anchorage, the avalanche pizza was definitely my favorite. Do come expecting to wait though, the crowds are heavy almost always

Awesome pizza. We got the veggie and Hawaiian style pie in a fifty fifty split. The crust is there best part. While I am not a beer drinker, the better half got a sampling of four and found them rather enjoyable.
Great pizzas and draught beer

Awesome pizza! Terrible service today.  I came in a group of military guys today.  The waitress tossed us the bill and made us do the work to split it.  It took our large table a long time to work out the bill.  On top of that she wanted 18% gratuity for the group which wasn't factored in the bill so we ended up coming short causing more frustration.

What ever happened to the mooses tooth that divided the bill and ran our cards? Are those days over? Now I have to calculate a tables bill out of a long list of orders from $300 worth of charges?

Maybe my money should be spent other places that can actually serve a table of hungry military guys.

I decided to go with my family to this place from reading all the good reviews. It's also the 3rd best pizza place in the u.s. They say. The pepperoni pizza is alright but I think it's loaded with lots of cheese and less sauce. I've had better pizza in places like New York. I don't think the food is worth the wait, only thing I enjoyed was the sweet and spicy hot wings.
Amazing beer selection. The pizza was very good but I would need to explore more before committing a 5 star review.

I have mixed emotions about this place. The food usually is pretty good. But its so over hyped that no matter when you go the wait is ridiculous. They have decent beer but no liquor licence. I usually will only go for special occasions that friends have there, otherwise i avoid due to how crowded it is.
Great pizza and beer, awsome place to hangout! Definitely a must if in town! Little spendy but worth it
Fantastic pizza and beer, just expect a long wait. It is worth it though
Simply the Best Pizza!!!

Very good pizza, Backpacker pizza is one of my favorites. Arrive early, because you might have to wait to get a table, and sometimes you need to circle the parking lot several times to find a parking space.
Great food and beer selection. Be prepared to wait.

Yeah yeah everybody loves this place. The menu fine whatever on the wait. But when your bill is $19 and you pay with a 50 and get your change in 1s. That's just plain rude. I had to go to the bar to get real change.
Lots of beer on tap
Best pizza in Alaska

This place is great, no argument here. It's the best pizza in town and the beer is fantastic. Try Santa's Little Helper or the Spicy Thai Chicken. I doubt you'll regret it. They also have awesome concerts here during the summer (Bear Tooth takes over during the winter, as well as having its own shows).
My only problem with Moose's Tooth is that it is SO popular. There is almost always a wait for a table, and you won't get seated until your entire party is present. I've come before and been quoted 45 minutes to an hour. At that point it's just easier to head over to the Bear Tooth!
Best pizza ever. Usually ridiculously busy, but I guess that's part of the fun. On lazy days sometimes we'll order to-go and just go pick it up. Good beer too!
This place is cool.
Excellent food, drinks & staff. Therefore they are busy, so be reasonable.
Best pizza in Anchorage. Period.

Nothing else comes close for pizza in Alaska. There's a reason this place is always packed.

My top pizzas are Steak Chipotle and Santa's Little Helper.

This is the best pizza you will find in Alaska! Their gourmet original pizzas are amazing! I have never taken anyone here who didn't love it and rave about it. The Amazing Apricot, Santa's Little Helper, and Avalanche are the three best pizzas on the menu! Diablo cheese sticks are awesome (yes they are extremely hot so be warned). The wait in the summers can be several hours so be prepared for a wait but enjoy the food once you do get in.

It's mooses tooth...it's delicious

Monthly specials and rotating taps keep it interesting
Such good pizza. I love the atmosphere and I love the beer. My favorite is the Northern Lights Amber. I recommend a growler of that and a wild mushroom pizza with Italian sausage!

This is a required stop if you're visiting Alaska. If you're coming here for dinner do expect a good wait. They have a patio area where you can hang out with your friends and a drink while you wait, so that helps the time fly by quicker.

The pizza here is the main attraction. My go-to is the Chicken Parmesan pizza. Never fails. Pair it with an apple ale and you're all set!

Almost hard to over-praise the Tooth- great variety of excellent pizzas, knowledgeable and helpful staff, and they're been doing great things with their beer brewing, especially in the last couple of years.  New varieties of IPAs and Belgians coming through the pipeline on a regular basis, and they hang onto their old favorites as well, like the  Pipeline Stout.  Only downside is that there's almost always a wait, but you can have a beer or two while you wait, so relax and enjoy the ambiance.
No complaints. Great pizza and great service. Worth the wait.
Always worth the wait. Best pizza and salads! Moved out of state for 3 years and craved this all the time. Never found another place like it.

The pizza here is how I judge all other pizza. Legendary. Their beer is outstanding as well, and if you want to try and be good, their buffalo chicken salad won't leave you jealous of the pizza eaters around you.

Delicious! This is an Anchorage favorite. Everyone recommends it and I agree! We've been about ten different times and it doesn't disappoint. Our favorites: spicy Thai, buffalo chicken, and brewhouse. And the raspberry wheat beer is tasty!
Best pizza and beer I have ever had.
Our favorite pizza in all of Anchorage.  Try the Classic. You won't be disappointed.
Great Beer, Good Pizza, Always packed house, And the Korean wings are excellent!

Wow!  This must be the happiest place in Anchorage.  Being on lists as the best pizza in Anchorage does not hurt the Moose's Tooth a bit.  Instead of dealing with the large crown, a take-out pizza was ordered.

From what I saw, the ambiance is great.  As for the pizza, it is quite delicious.  $20 for a medium specialty.

Yes, there are ALWAYS long lines for this place, because it is totally worth the wait. The wild mushroom pizza (I ask for it with red sauce) is incredible. The microbrews are delicious! The salads are fresh, innovative and very good. there's no way to go wrong with this place.
Delicious pizza and good brewed root beer and cream soda for those who don't drink alcohol. The only trouble is waiting in line for dinner, but the wait is worth the wait.
I've not enjoyed the food there recently. I feel like they are living off their reputation at this point. Couple that with the long wait times and it's not worth it.

Waited at the counter 20 minutes for my take out. To add insult to the experience, I was IGNORED most of the time and had to jockey for attention, which was unprofessional. Sorry, I'm not a hot tall babe, BOYS!
Best pizza in town.  Beer is second to none.  Definitely one of the top 5 restaurants in all of Alaska.

Food its great
Atmosphere is great
Service was lacking when there were a group of ours

Too many customers plus an unprepared staff equates to very poor service.
My wife and I met there for our I HOUR lunch one day,,,,,,,,,,and
waited 50 minutes for our pizza to hit the table.
Maybe it was just a fluke day for them.
Regardless, I will never eat there again,,,,,,,,,ever.
Food is delicious, service is great, great beer and a fun place to hang out. Diablo breadsticks...OMG, died & went to heaven
Good pizza at a good price.  I order mine to go though as the line can be awfully long for a table.  Favorite brew:  Midtown Brown.

Food is made by gods. And the beer flows from the heavens.
Their sandwiches are great. Their soup is wonderful. Avalanche is my all time favorite. But the BLT is better, just only available as a special. Great place! Worth the $$$ and the wait.

The only improvement would be to add a second floor.
Good, unique pizzas.  Very popular place, be prepared to wait a long time for your table.
good service, great micro  brews, yummy pizza, a little bit of a wait but never too bad
i love their apple ales, and the mushroom pizza ! sucks they dont do reservations & that the 45 min wait is everytime you go, regardless of time of day
